item.title: Storage facility raided as feds investigate alleged ISIS-inspired NYC bomb throwers
item.summary: Federal investigation underway after Pennsylvania students accused of explosive attack outside mayor's residence. ISIS inspiration concerns cited.

item.title: 21 Iranian women’s soccer players weigh return home after 5 granted asylum
item.summary: Australia granted asylum to five Iranian women's soccer players who sought safety while visiting for a tournament, although the fate of the rest of team remains uncertain.

item.title: 5 Iranian women's soccer players receive asylum in Australia after Trump pressure
item.summary: At least five Iranian women's soccer players were granted asylum in Australia after the country received added pressure from President Donald Trump on Monday.

item.title: Tyler Linderbaum's $81M record-breaking deal headlines Raiders' free agent spending spree
item.summary: The Raiders made Tyler Linderbaum the highest-paid interior lineman in league history with an $81M deal, as Las Vegas goes all-in during the NFL free agency tampering period.

item.title: The Hitchhiker’s Guide to the 'talking filibuster' and the SAVE Act
item.summary: Republicans push to alter Senate filibuster rules to pass Trump's SAVE Act requiring citizenship proof for voting, despite significant procedural hurdles.

item.title: Biden-appointed judge in the hot seat after DHS fires back at 'false' claims about ICE facility
item.summary: The Biden-tapped federal judge ruled that detainees were 'stuffed into unclean cells’ at an ICE holding center in Baltimore, and ordered substantive changes, prompting backlash from DHS.

item.title: At least 40 percent of California teachers plan to quit in the next decade: survey
item.summary: Teacher shortage crisis affects California as 40% consider leaving education due to financial issues, while nationwide 35% of teachers plan to exit the profession in the next decade.

item.title: Aaron Judge, Paul Skenes power Team USA over Mexico to secure spot in World Baseball Classic quarterfinal
item.summary: Team USA is heading to the quarterfinals in the World Baseball Classic, as Aaron Judge and Roman Anthony hits home runs, while Paul Skenes dominated Mexico's lineup on Monday night.

item.title: Trump reveals top issues GOP should focus on to secure midterms victory: 'I've never been more confident'
item.summary: Trump outlined a five-point legislative bucket list he says will secure GOP midterm victories, including voter ID and transgender policy restrictions at Republican conference.

item.title: Trump says it’s an ‘honor’ to keep Strait of Hormuz open for China and other countries
item.summary: President says he will keep the Strait of Hormuz open for the world, including China, while announcing plans to waive oil sanctions to lower energy prices.
